info.cls_ename: Professional Master's Program of Graduate Institute of Financial and Economic Law

description.describe_ch: 本學期著重於擴大學生的國際視野及培養學生對處理複雜的國際事件時所必需的基本能力。學生必須閱讀英文法律期刊、文章、法規和判例，並有充分的機會練習及加強法學英文的聽、說、讀、寫能力。
description.describe_eh: This semester is focus on foster, cultivate and broaden the international perspective and to develop students' ability to analyze as well as deal with the complexity of international events. Students will be required to read law journal articles, commercial legislation and case laws in English to advance students' fluent legal English ability.

targets.describe_ch: 介紹法律英文對於商業律師之重要性，保持學生對法律英文之學習興趣。
targets.describe_en: To introduce some of the language-related aspects of the work of a commercial lawyer, and keep students’ learning motive.

targets.describe_ch: 透過法律信和備忘錄的寫作，加強學生法律英文寫作能力。
targets.describe_en: To improve students' ability to write common legal text types in English, such as letters or memorandums.

targets.describe_ch: 培養在法律、政治、經濟、金融等領域之涵養。
targets.describe_en: To foster, cultivate students in law, politics, economics, business and finance.

targets.describe_ch: 透過課堂的討論及報告，加強學生法律英文說的能力。
targets.describe_en: To strengthen students' speaking skills and to enable students to engage more effectively in a range of speaking situations typical of the study of law and the practice of law such as client interviews or discussions with colleagues and fellow students.
